decision_rule: Continue beyond smoke PPO only if behavior retention, zero-response degradation, and strict outcome proof-surface gates remain at or above the M133 level.
failure_criteria: normal behavior success regresses below M124/M132
strict proof-surface diversity regresses below M133
M62 or other controls become admitted
PPO uses hidden or oracle actor inputs
hypothesis: M133 admits the s60 repair for guarded PPO readiness. A small PPO continuation may improve closed-loop behavior only if it preserves the newly recovered rollout-margin proof surface.
success_criteria: PPO smoke run completes from the s60 checkpoint
normal behavior retention remains at M124/M132 level
strict outcome proof-surface diversity does not regress below M133
PPO readiness or rejection is recorded before any larger run
